title: Synctext message 'How long will you be down here for?' with no reception at the Baltic anomaly
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Synctext message 'How long will you be down here for?' with no reception at the Baltic anomaly, about 2020s at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I get a text on my phone and you can ask anybody there with me about this happening and they'll all corroborate this story. And it's a text on Synctext and it says, "How long will you be down here for?"

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a trip to the Baltic Sea anomaly, an unusual shape on the seabed between Sweden and Finland. He says that while there, with no phone reception, he got a text on a messaging app called Synctext asking, "How long will you be down here for?" and that everyone with him would back up the story; if true, it would mean something at the site was reaching out to him.
